title: StitchLogic
description: A garment manufacturing and production management platform for tracking orders, production stages, and operational workflows.
longDescription: StitchLogic streamlines garment factory operations by centralizing order management, production tracking, inventory monitoring, and workflow coordination into a single platform.
problem: Garment factories often rely on spreadsheets and manual processes, causing inefficiencies, production delays, and poor visibility into ongoing operations.
solution: Built a centralized system that tracks production progress, manages orders, and provides real-time visibility across manufacturing workflows.
challenges: Designing flexible production pipelines while maintaining accurate status tracking across multiple manufacturing stages.
learnings: Gained experience designing workflow-driven applications and managing complex business processes.

title: Syncora
description: A collaborative team management and productivity platform with real-time communication and task coordination.
longDescription: Syncora helps teams organize projects, manage tasks, collaborate in real time, and maintain workflow transparency through an intuitive dashboard.
problem: Teams frequently struggle with fragmented communication and disconnected project management tools.
solution: Developed a unified workspace that combines project tracking, team collaboration, and real-time updates.
challenges: Maintaining real-time synchronization between users while ensuring data consistency.
learnings: Deepened understanding of collaborative software architecture and real-time systems.

title: EduAnalytics
description: An educational analytics platform that provides insights into student performance and institutional outcomes.
longDescription: EduAnalytics transforms educational data into actionable insights through interactive dashboards, performance tracking, and predictive analytics.
problem: Educational institutions often have access to large amounts of student data but lack meaningful insights for decision-making.
solution: Created a data visualization and analytics platform that highlights performance trends and key educational metrics.
challenges: Processing and visualizing large datasets while keeping the interface intuitive for non-technical users.
learnings: Learned advanced data visualization techniques and dashboard design principles.

title: Smart Inventory System
description: An inventory and stock management solution for businesses to monitor products, suppliers, and stock movement.
longDescription: Smart Inventory System helps businesses maintain accurate stock levels, track inventory movement, manage suppliers, and generate operational reports.
problem: Manual inventory tracking leads to stock discrepancies, operational inefficiencies, and poor forecasting.
solution: Built a digital inventory management platform with automated stock tracking and reporting capabilities.
challenges: Ensuring inventory consistency across multiple operations and transactions.
learnings: Developed expertise in transactional data management and inventory workflows.
